newsitem.title: USA: Hartford sees global growth for unit.
newsitem.headline: Hartford sees global growth for unit.

text.p: The Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and Insurance Co said Thursday it saw a growth potential of 20 percent a year for its international unit as more countries open up their borders to business.

"HSB Engineering Insurance Ltd, which now writes business in more than 60 countries worldwide, has doubled its revenues in the past three years," it said. "As more countries become industrialized, as more industries are freed from government control, and as profitability becomes more important, the potential is there for 20 percent annual growth."

The company said it also saw "good growth and profitability in engineering services, both domestically and internationally" for HSB Reliability Technologies, its reliability improvement consulting and services firm.
It said it was closely monitoring the Radian International LLC joint venture it had with Dow Chemical Co.
It said the venture had provided a good opportunity "to combine its business and skill sets with those of the environmental businesses of Dow.

"Now Radian's management, with the support of Dow and HSB, is working hard to complete the transition which is necessary to improve Radian's results," it said. "At the same time, we also have the option in 1998 of exercising a put that would pay HSB approximately $145 million."
Hartford owns 40 percent in the venture, while Dow owns the other 60 percent.
Hartford reported a first-quarter profit of $0.78 a share against $0.84 for the same period last year.
